awc-2019.notes: Source 1 disagrees with the earlier reader: the copy now held is the 2019 site (snapshot 2019-12-11). The scoreboard (65 rows incl. 13 with zero solved) and the standings (53 teams) differ in count; the scoreboard does not mark official versus other teams.

sources.disagreement: The earlier reader found a front page announcing 23 and 24 December 2022; our copy of the site, as it stood on 2019-12-11, is the 2019 edition's site and names no other edition.
sources.evidence: The home page is headed 'The 2019 ICPC Asia -West Continent Final Contest' and says the contest will be held in January 2020 at Tehran and Kolkata.
CodeMarshal page titled 'ICPC Asia West Continent Final Contest 2019' with 65 team rows and columns A to M, marked 'The standings is now finalized'.
Table of 53 team rows with Rank, Team, Institution, Solved, Time, Citation columns, titled 'The 2019 ICPC Asia -West Continent Final Contest'.
17-page PDF with statements headed A. Disk Tree through K. XOR Dice, eleven problems A to K.

awc-2022.notes: Source 2 is the 2022 Dhaka regional board (another contest). Source 4 (result.pdf, 1 page, 58 teams, no title) matches the awc-2021 results (see awc-2021 scoreboard: DU_NotStrongEnough, Three of a Kind, BUET Potatoes at the top), so it probably belongs to awc-2021, not awc-2022; it names no contest itself.

sources.evidence: The board is titled '2022 ICPC ASIA DHAKA REGIONAL CONTEST hosted by GREEN UNIVERSITY OF BANGLADESH' and lists 162 teams, mostly Bangladeshi, on ten problems A to J.
Table of 61 team rows with Rank, Team, Institution, Solved, Time, Citation, titled 'The 2022 ICPC Asia West Continent Final Contest'.

The one-page PDF lists 58 teams with first place DU_NotStrongEnough on 8 solved, the same top places and counts as the 2021 Finals scoreboard dated 24 Dec 2022, and its file date is 30 Dec 2022, not the 2022 edition's May 2023.
